title: Earlier homes and a family loss in Birmingham
summary: She says she lived on Sixth and Conn, then left Birmingham after losing a baby; a doctor said the girl could have no more children.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Did you ever live on Magazine Street? Constance?

No, I lived on Sixth and Conn. Sixth and Conn. I enrolled in the Dallas State about two years. That's when I left Birmingham. Actually lost a little girl. And they lived there two years. Johnny took a demotion and came back. That's why I lost her baby in Birmingham. She wasn't going to say that. The little girl that she was around. She wasn't blind. I had to go there for six weeks. Doctor said she could never have any more children.
